title: Roots
description: A 1.8.9 pvp texture pack based arround swamps and mushrooms
body:
The Roots [16x] is a texture pack made around a purple-ish theme that is mainly based around swamps and mushrooms.


It's a Purple pvp texture pack made for 1.8.9 bedwars but can be used overall in other pvp gamemodes.


It takes a great inspiration from Peak's Roots Update while also keeping a full creative liberty on the textures and inspirations


Here are some ingame screenshots of the texture pack :


![Roots - #1](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/d370c3e5ced10b4c3249f59342c9bba5e0bab30d.jpeg)

![Roots - #2](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/38a1b643421f72df6e005b619dd55d553036b9bd.jpeg)

![Roots - #3](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/0376435464f8cebfcd2a8142a39c5fac7cc199df.jpeg)


Sidenote : Feel free to join the discord if there is any issues with the Texture pack (Rendering Issues, Crashes, Textures not working properly, Sky glitches and/or not rendering...) It helps us greatly improve the work we do and provide the best for you all !
